notes.title: World Patch!
notes.notes:
[H1]World Map Update[/h1]

[b]Hello,

Welcome to the latest update to Zeus’ Battlegrounds. The Arena limited time mode has concluded and we appreciate the feedback. The world map has returned along with the additional game modes.[/b]

 [H1]Gameplay Updates[/h1]

•	Fixed an issue with game menu settings not saving.
•	Fixed an issue with dodge where players could repeatedly parry and attack causing the character to look like it was gaining multiple attacks.
•	Added a key binding for dodge that will be affected by the character directional input.
•	Fixed an issue where players might be able to dodge multiple times while tapping quickly.
•	Fixed issue where arrow would not display when bow/crossbow is pulled.
•	Increased loot spawn points in arena.


[b]We appreciate the feedback and support you have given us. We continue to work on improving the game. Have a great week and see you in game!

Sincerely,

Industry Games[/b]

notes.notes:
Good Afternoon,


We have a quick patch to adjust the Arena Map game mode as well as some additional fixes.

[b]Gameplay Update[/b]

•	Delay before first Battlezone rule starts reduced to 10 seconds, down from 60
•	Adjusted arena warmup time from 60s to 30s, warmup players from 20 to 10 and playzone reduction time for its only rule from 180s to 90s

notes.title: Arena Map! - Limited Time Mode
notes.notes:
[H1]Arena Map Update[/h1]

[b]Hello,

Welcome to the latest update to Zeus’ Battlegrounds. We are excited to bring you the Arena Map as a limited time game mode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31277096/ff0b94fb8acefb1fd57b7f21873fdbb3e5cfdd88.jpg[/img]

Demigods are thrown into close quarters combat with up to 40 other combatants. There are no God Gifts in this mode and the matches are set to last between 5-10 minutes each. We anticipate this game mode being available for a limited time and will be the only mode available while we test it out.[/b]



 [H1]Gameplay Updates[/h1]

•	Fixed issue with UI losing focus when using a controller
•	Update UI and item localization
•	Optimized weapon swapping for orbs, thrown weapons and bolts when one type is consumed, the next available weapon of that type should equip in the same slot as the previous weapon of that type.
•	Fire arrows have had their AoE damage reduced. Direct hits will now do 110% damage to target but only 20% weapon damage to targets within 2 meters of impact.
•	Lightning arrows have had their chain ranged reduced to 5 meters.
•	AoE damage on items is still reduced by the armor factor of the chest only.
•	Updated several armor sets to reduced clipping
•	Improved Leaderboard UI
•	Improved lobby UI loading time
•	Fixed Zeus animations


[b]We appreciate the feedback  and support you have given us. We will continue to work on improving the game you are helping us build. Have a great week and see you in game!

Sincerely,

Industry Games[/b]

Hello all,

[b]We greatly appreciate the feedback you have given us and will continue to work on improving the game based on your feedback and suggestions. 

Sincerely, 

Industry Games[/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Season Pass for All Players!
notes.notes:
As of the last update, all players now have the Season 0 Pass for the game, which means anyone that plays can collect 50 levels of premium in-game items, just by playing.

We had a great response when we made the Season Pass free for 12 hours a couple weeks ago, and we decided we wanted everyone to have this experience and be able to get all the items in Season 0 as they level up their characters.

We also want to thank the community for all of the support as we’ve navigated our first month of Steam Early Access and made many improvements to the game. All of the updates and tuning are a result of everyone really supporting the game and encouraging the team. We are very grateful to have such awesome players.

And if you already bought a season pass, thank you for your support! You'll find some Favor on your account that you can use in the shop.

Hop in and have fun!

notes.title: Halloween 2018 Update
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Update 10/26/2018[/h1][/b]

[b]Hello All,
This week’s patch includes many changes and updates. [/b]

[h1] World Update -  Halloween!![/h1]

Halloween is almost here and the Isle of Thera is ready! The map features new lighting, art and an environment theme to get ready for the holiday. Jump in today and play in the mode for a limited time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31277096/8d331b1a2384b4f2f609a7309b5359592fb901a1.png[/img]
Something spooky lurks ahead...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31277096/f619764749bc89d76df2578bbc486620d632b626.png[/img]
A ghostly aura encompasses the Isle.


[H1]Leaderboard[/h1]

The leaderboard was fixed and updated last week. As we had said previously, we are running a short monthly leader contest that will run until the remainder of the month. We wanted to honor the player who has led the boards for most of early access, [b]inflameZ[/b], until the contest ends at the end of the month. You will be able to find statues honoring [b]inflameZ[/b]'s achievement throughout the world. Upon conclusion of each month, the leading player will have their statue patched into the game soon after the month ends.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31277096/c92f917f651c5bc24e889c51d307659388f177f7.png[/img]

 [H1]Spectating[/h1]

We have added the ability for players to spectate other players upon death. In single-player mode, you will be able to cycle among the remaining players to view their gameplay. In duo and team modes you will be able to spectate your team while players on your team remain. When all players are eliminated, you may spectate the remaining players.

•	Enabled Spectate in all gameplay modes.
•	Players may hit Next to cycle to next player.
•	When players want to exit, they may click the Back button and this will take them back to their finish screen to exit the match.

[H1]Gameplay[/h1]

•	Fixed several localization issues. Players should now see text that is appropriate for their selected language.
•	An option to always run has been added to the options menu for players
•	Fixed several impact sound issues with thrown weapons and arrows
•	Reduced the amount of time between several of the middle circles reducing match time by approximately 3 minutes.
•	Added a 1-second cooldown to speed potions to prevent players from accidentally using more than one at a time
•	Fixed issues where clothing would not equip when changing your appearance
•	Fixed issue with debuffs and buffs not displaying when mounted.
•	Reduced the damage of fire arrows from 120% weapon damage to 100%

 [H1]UI & Store[/h1]

•	Simplified store layout for ease of navigation.
•	New items have been added to the store.
•	Item purchase flow has been simplified.


We’re excited to bring you the first of many events and hope to see you in the game!

Sincerely,

Industry Games

notes.notes:

Hello Demigods!

Things are getting spooky on the Isle of Thera… This Halloween themed screenshot contest is a chance for you to showcase your creativity AND win some awesome prizes. Be as creative as you like and showcase your spooky side in Zeus’ Battlegrounds. Show us your best bone-chilling, hair-raising, and eerie screenshots this Halloween season!

The Halloween Screenshot Contest ends [b]October 31st, 2018 at 11:59 PM PDT.[/b]

[b]Prizes:[/b]
First place – 2,000 favor
Second place – 1,000 favor
Third place – 750 favor

[b]Rules and Screenshot requirements:[/b]

- At least 1280 x 720 resolution, no larger than 1920x1080
- No player names visible (press F8 to disable your HUD)
- Screenshots must be yours. Any plagiarized content will be disqualified
- One entry per person. You may edit your submission any time before October 31st 2018 at 11:59 PM PDT. Revise your submission by editing the original post.
- No photoshop, editing, or filters are allowed. You may post an edited version along with the original. Only the original will be judged in the contest.

[b]How to participate:[/b]

- Capture your screenshot in-game using any image capturing software.
- Post your screenshot as a reply to the [url=https://forums.zeusbattlegrounds.com/topic/69/halloween-screenshot-contest-entries/24]"Halloween Screenshot Contest Entries"[/url] thread in our forums. Include your in-game username in the post.

[b]Tips and tricks:[/b]

- Hold ALT to move the camera around your character in-game.
- There are several spooky places to check out around the Isle of Thera.
- Press F8 to hide your HUD. This can easily be turned back on by pressing F8 again.
- Try to play with your quality settings as high as possible.
- Cosmetics are not required for this contest.

Submissions close October 31st, 2018, at 11:59 PM PDT. Screenshots submitted after this time will not be considered.

Our team will select the 3 winning screenshots. These winners will be announced on our Dev Q&A Stream on November 2nd, 2018 at 12 PM PDT and will be contacted via PM on our forums.

notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.notes:
Hello All,

We have been working to implement our final system which will reset the leaderboards at the beginning of each month. Unfortunately, applying these changes to the leaderboards corrupted the leaderboard data.

There is no way to restore the previous leaderboard. We understand what went wrong and have corrected it. We had intended to reset the leaderboard November 1, 2018, GMT 0. Because of the error, and to incentivize players who had been playing for a top position, we are going to reset the leaderboard completely today at 8 pm PST. We will run the monthly ranking until the end of October. After October is over the top players, from today until November 1, will receive their item. We had always intended a special honor for the #1 player in the game from month to month. The top player will have a statue of their character placed in the world commemorating their achievement. After this, all season resets should occur on the 1st day of each month at GMT 0.

We do apologize for the frustration many of you have voiced regarding this. We hope that leveling the playing field and offering the incentive will help to make things right. We appreciate your support and patience as we navigate Early Access.
 
Sincerely,
 
Industry Games

notes.title: Update 10/20/2018
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings,

We’re excited to bring you the next round of updates based upon your feedback. As a reminder, we will be offering a free Season Pass today to the first 25,000 players starting at 8 AM PDT.  We continue to focus one game performance and combat based upon your feedback. We have several awesome Halloween items coming in next weeks patch![/b]

 
[H1]Languages[/h1]
•	Localization support for Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Russian

[H1]Gameplay[/h1]

•	Corrected the behavior of blocking with shields. Shields should now correctly block a portion of damage based upon the block value of the shield. 
•	Player starting clothing now has a base armor amount added to it for initial increased survivability. All player starting items reduce a portion of damage but should be upgraded by looting armor upon landing on the Island.
•	We identified and fixed several bugs regarding how hits were calculated. A weapon's ability to hit should feel more consistent to players. Weapon types (axe, sword, 1 hand/2hand) should feel more standardized by class.
•	One handed weapons have had their hit range extended slightly to accommodate movement speed of combat.
•	Polearm (Spear) had a larger refactor due to inadequate hitbox detection. The hit box now more closely approximates the animation visible to the player.
•	Refactored collision on several world assets including the Arena. Players should find that collision of the bezels and other modified geometry now more closely approximates what they see.
•	Fixed several LOD’s for improved performance.
•	Dual Wield speed bonus increased to 25%
•	Dual Wield damage bonus increased to 15%
•	Optimized weapon assets

[H1]UI[/h1]
•	Updated Store layout
•	Fixed UI bug that makes it appear as though items have been duplicated when inventory is full
•	Support and currency conversion for 40 different currency types
•	Text on several items simplified
•	Season Passes display a season number when in inventory



[b]We greatly appreciate the feedback you have given us and will continue to work on improving the game you are helping us build. We are looking to have our first regional server group online with-in the next week (starting with the EU) as well as several other enhancements you have requested (i.e. spectating upon death). Have a great weekend and see you in game!

Sincerely,

Industry Games[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes | 10/11/18
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 10/11/2018[/h1]
Hello All,
 
We appreciate all the support of the last few weeks and have some fixes and an update for you. We are focused on improving the game while listening to your feedback and addressing the issues most concerning to you. We will continue to prioritize the items players feel are most important along with those that we are still looking to implement.
 
[H1]Store Update[/H1]
 
New items have been added to the in-game store. Be sure to check them out!
 
•            Grim Reaper Scythe
•            Void Reaver Sword
•            Cape of Athena
 
[H1]Gameplay[/h1]
 
•            Reduced the speed debuff when damaged (was 35%, now 10%)
•            Fixed an issue that would cause emotes to stop working when switching appearances
•            Fixed issue causing items to be deleted when looting with a full inventory
•            Fixed an issue with drag and drop of items. Dragging and dropping items should be more responsive in addition to being able to be dragged straight from vicinity loot to equip.
•            Fixed potion-specific key binds
•            Fixed issue where auto-run would stop when leaving mounts
•            Fixed issue where sprint would stop when leaving mounts
•            Fixed an issue where Zeus’ Gift would not always hit targets near point blank range
•            Fixed an issue where Zeus’ Gift would sometimes hit the same target twice (it can still hit multiple targets, just no more than once per target)
•            Fixed a rare potential issue where melee hits could avoid armor calculation
•            Fixed some bugs that could occur when a passenger enters a chariot
•            Chests that have been looted should stay open, remaining unlooted items may be viewed via <Tab> in the vicinity loot.
•            Favor shows red when you do not have enough for a purchase
•            Corrected LOD of a common bush so players hiding in these are not revealed at a distance
 
[H1]Security[/h1]
•            Additional security provisions have been added to detect the use of cheat programs and prevent manipulation of speed in-game
•            Players who team up in solo matches have begun to receive suspensions/bans for this behavior.
 
Thanks for the feedback. Have a great weekend and see you in game!
 
Sincerely,
 
Industry Games

notes.title: Duos & Teams Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1

Hello All,

Thank you for all the feedback and we are happy to bring the first patch post launch. 

[H1]Duos and Teams[/h1]
We have added Duos as a gameplay option for players. The default option for this (as well as teams) is for auto fill to be on. This can be adjusted when selecting the play mode (pressing the “Solo” default button in the lower right corner of the Lobby). You can manually invite your Steam friends from the friends list in the upper left corner.
•	Enabled Duo gameplay mode accessible through the lobby UI
•	Fixed an issue in team matchmaking that would cause players to remain in lobby preventing them from finding a game session.

[H1]Gameplay[/h1]
•	Fixed an issue that would cause player characters to have incorrect skin tone
•	Turning is no longer frame rate dependent, the turn rate is now consistent across all frame rates.
•	Increased crouch turning rate.
•	Reduced warm up period to 60 seconds
•	Character name length is now limited
•	Fixed issues where incorrect death message was displayed
•	Fixed season pass experience rewards to auto consume. 
•	Increased horse mount speed, horses now are slightly faster than chariots.
•	Optimized ambient occlusion and specular values on world assets.
•	Fixed issue that would cause a slain players inventory not to display when looting.
•	Fixed revive issue in teams and duos where players would get “Target not found” notice.
•	Adjusted base heavy crossbow asset.
•	Fixed issue where loot would cause collision, stopping combat.
•	Fixed an issue that would cause player item selection not to save. Player items should now save upon lobby exit.

 [H1]UI[/h1]
•	Fixed descriptions of some items in the store to make them clearer.
•	Purchased items will now show as purchased in the store.
•	Initial UI lobby pass to handle more than 30 items (clothing)
o	These items will be updated and in player inventory later this week.

There is more to come in the coming days and weeks. We appreciate all the feedback and support so far.

Sincerely,

Industry Games

notes.title: Teaming in SOLO matches
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We want to address the issue of teaming in SOLO matches since it has been reported by many players.  This is just our 3rd day in Early Access and we are still sorting out many issues.  Unfortunately, Teaming did not work as intended and it appears that many of you have taken matters into your own hands by self-teaming in SOLO matches.  We do have a fix for the TEAM matchmaking and are even looking at including a new DUO mode as well.  I would respectfully ask those of you that have been Teaming in SOLO matches to knock it off 😊.  It ruins the "last demigod standing" experience.  The patch with the fixes I mentioned takes place tomorrow, Tue. (10/2).  After that, those of you who like to team please use the TEAM or DUOS options.  All of us here at Industry Games consider ourselves very nice people (especially Iris the Community Manager) but don't think we won't resort to stronger measures if this continues.  We are hoping it never comes to that and that with this new patch, tomorrow this issue corrects itself.  

Thanks,

Warren

Industry Games

notes.title: Early Access Known Issues
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks for jumping in on the first day of Early Access.  We are working hard to make sure we can sort out issues as fast as you find them.
  
I wanted to make you aware of known issues that we should be able to resolve in the next 24 hours:

Issue 1: Some cosmetic items in the season pass are not showing up in inventory.
These items are actually being awarded to your account and after our fix will be in your inventory.

Issue 2: Not able to purchase Helm or Shield from shop.
Like the season pass items, if you purchase the Helm or Shield it is actually awarded to your account but is not visible.  Our fix will make you have these items available.

Issue 3: Not able to do damage
Some players are being flagged as being on a team and are unable to damage each other.  This is being corrected.

Issue 4: Network Error 4 crash
The servers had a setting that caused them to turn off in the middle of some early games.  This has been resolved.

Thanks again for joining us for Early Access.
Warren

notes.title: Zeus' Battlegrounds to Enter Steam Early Access on Friday, September 28th
notes.notes:
UPDATE: Please refer to our Discussion boards for updates on Early Access launch. 

6:30 PM PDT update: We are in the final stages of internal testing and are aiming at launching this evening. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31277096/3b78d0c148e862ec97f74614a53e40c3a10eb153.png[/img]
On Friday, [b]September 28nd at 10AM PDT[/b], Zeus’ Battlegrounds, a free-to-play melee-based 100 player Battle Royale game will launch on Steam in Early Access. The game has been in closed beta testing for months and is now ready to open up to a wider audience. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31277096/89a56b1ee90846533e13f7e430061f97bc07d1cc.png[/img]

Anyone who logs into the game in the first week will be prompted to claim an in-game [b]founder’s crown[/b] that once claimed, will be permanently attached to their account. The crown is not tradeable, so it will show other players that the crown-wearer was in the founding group of players for Zeus’ Battlegrounds.

Zeus’ Battlegrounds offers in-game cosmetic items for player character customization. The cosmetic items do not affect gameplay. The game also offers two season pass formats where players can progress through 50 levels of rewards. Season passes are priced at $9.99 for the standard tier and $19.99 for the premium tier. The premium tier season pass includes a 25 level boost and instantly grants a number of items to the player that can be achieved over the first half of the season. Players who do not participate in the season pass still have an opportunity to gain cosmetic items for playing and through in-game actions

For more information, visit [url=zeusbattlegrounds.com]the Zeus' Battlegrounds website[/url] or join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/olympus]Discord Server.[/url]

notes.title: Sign up for Beta access now! - Zeus' Battlegrounds
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We are excited to announce the beta release of Zeus’ Battlegrounds! 

Register for beta access now at: www.zeusbattlegrounds.com. We will be conducting multiple tests in the coming weeks leading to an official launch. 

Check out the announcement trailer here. 

About Zeus’ Battlegrounds

Zeus' Battlegrounds is a free-to-play, melee-based, 100+ player Battle Royale game set in the time of Olympus and the Greek Gods. Gear up and prepare for battle in the fight of your life! Summoned by Zeus for the ultimate test of cunning and will, your challenge is to defeat all other Demigods in order to take your rightful place on Olympus.

Are you mortal, or are you a GOD?

Features
Free-to-Play Melee-based Battle Royale Game
Fight as a Demigod in action packed battles including God powers
100 players per game 
Season format where you can earn dozens of cosmetic items 
Huge world (Additional combat areas will be added regularly)
Play Solo or in Teams of up to 4 players
Leaderboards show current rankings and personal stats
Legendary weapons 
4 levels of Godlike Armor
Customizable male and female characters
Play in 1st or 3rd person view
